metadata.evidence: In this study, we aim to enhance the arithmetic reasoning ability of Large Language Models (LLMs) through zero-shot prompt optimization.
metadata.reason: Defines the research task addressed by the artifact.

metadata.evidence: To address this, we introduce Prompt-OIRL, which harnesses offline inverse reinforcement learning to draw insights from offline prompting demonstration data.
metadata.reason: Names the core technical method used by the artifact.

metadata.value: first learning an offline reward model... Subsequently, a best-of-N strategy is deployed to recommend the optimal prompt
metadata.normalized_value: first learning an offline reward model... Subsequently, a best-of-N strategy is deployed to recommend the optimal prompt
metadata.evidence: With Prompt-OIRL, the query-dependent prompt optimization objective is achieved by first learning an offline reward model. This model can evaluate any query-prompt pairs without accessing LLMs. Subsequently, a best-of-N strategy is deployed to recommend the optimal prompt.
metadata.reason: Describes the two-stage pipeline (reward model learning + best-of-N selection), useful for understanding and reuse.
